caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet positioned in profile facing left. The bonnet is made of a brown fabric with tightly gathered, ruched bands running from the front brim to the back. The edge of the bonnet is trimmed with a soft, frilly white lace that lines the inner edge and extends slightly outward. Attached to the base of the bonnet is a large, checked ribbon in a pattern of brown, white, and blue intersecting lines, tied into an elaborate bow with extended tails. The background is plain and off-white, and no other objects or details are present in the composition.
title: Bonnet
